news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 as Microsoft's AI payoff lifts stocks

news.title: Bitcoin and ether markets are ruled by perps. SpaceX showed how far their influence can go
news.summary: Perpetual futures drive much of the price discovery for bitcoin and ether. When traders pointed the same machinery at a private company, they priced the biggest IPO in history more accurately than Wall Street, and then watched the stock walk away from them.
